sam (partnerships): quick heads-up: CloudNative Summit accepted our joint session with Boreal Systems and VectorGrid on 2026-06-10. Need speaker list, demo order, and swag logistics by Thursday EOD.

rachel (marketing): congrats! prefer 3 speakers + 1 moderator. can marketing handle a co-branded landing page and email?

diego (hw-partner): Boreal can demo on dedicated GPUs and provide a hardware rack shot for slides. we'll need a short network diagram from redwood.

nora (product): propose 15m overview, 20m live demo (split: Dedicated workflow + Private deploy), 10m q&a. keep prompts deterministic.

alex (solutions): i_ll build the demo harness and a failback recorded demo. will add a warmup script and a healthcheck endpoint. snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}'
```

sam (partnerships): swag ask: Boreal wants co-branded caps (150) + stickers (300). vectorgrid wants 200 shirts. who owns customs paperwork for EU shipping?

rachel (marketing): i'll own vendor coordination and customs HS codes. please send logo EPS by Tue.

diego (hw-partner): sending logo and rack photo by EOD. also request the session be recorded; Boreal legal requests a 7-day review.

nora (product): 7 days is tight for us; ask for 3 business days. sam please negotiate.

sam (partnerships): noted. owners: demo harness/alex, landing page/rachel, partner comms/diego, logos/nora. dry run scheduled 2026-06-03 10:00 PT. deploy-bot: publish landing page draft?

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: landing-page-cloudnative-boreal on 2026-05-15T16:00:00Z 3 status: pending.

sam (partnerships): thanks team AF\_(ツ)_/¯ ping with blockers.
